comments.body:
Fixed by #799 (merged, `f25cf37973`).

Before the restart, with Aggressive in force, the untrusted-content labels on and a sandbox Corbanu applies, the inspector's "This session" rows (and the `/security` review's "now" values) now say what Core enforces:
- Sandbox: "…; under Aggressive approved and allow-listed commands stay inside the sandbox";
- Network: "off for agent commands" (when the sandbox network is off);
- Vault: "the vault store and sign-in file are unreadable (Aggressive, also when you approve a command) to agent commands, and direct `corbanu vault …` commands are refused".

Without the labels, or with an external sandbox, nothing more is claimed than the refused vault commands. Wording only; Permissive in force is unchanged.

Replay of AGG-04 (GLM 5.3 Flash, disposable home): [video](https://github.com/CorbanuCore/CorbanuTerminal/releases/download/demos/issue-792-issue792-inspector-vault-before-restart-409064da15b4-2026-10-14.mp4); before/after screens in `qa/security-levels/fixes/issue-792-20261014/`.

title: Aggressive before restart: inspector's "This session" Vault row says the vault store and sign-in file are readable while Core denies them
